name: Dimitrios Karras
bio:
Dimitrios's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics, before transitioning into the world of motorsport management. He started as a data analyst for a small racing team, quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp analytical skills and innovative approach to strategy. 

Dimitrios is known for his data-driven decision-making and collaborative leadership style. He believes in fostering a team environment where every member feels valued and empowered. His flexible approach allows him to adapt quickly to changing circumstances, ensuring the team remains competitive. He aims to bring a fresh perspective and strategic vision to any organization he joins.

What sets Dimitrios apart is his ability to blend technical expertise with strong interpersonal skills. He can effectively communicate complex technical information to both engineers and drivers, fostering clear understanding and seamless collaboration.
